# Keys and commands

Every action strig has, the view it belongs to, its default keys and its help text, read from the same registries the help overlay (`?`) uses. A multi-key sequence is written with spaces (`g g` means `g` then `g`); `ctrl+d` is the control key; a shifted letter is the letter itself (`G`).

An action's name is the stable name it keeps whatever its keys are. A name that appears in more than one view (`next-tab`, `next-section`, `copy-url`) applies to that view's content. A command runs from the command line (`:` then `enter`); an action with no keys is reached only by its command.

## Shared defaults

Movement, search and help defaults shared by the views. Each key applies where the active view and pane support its action.

| Action | Keys | Command | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `down` | `j` |  | down |
| `up` | `k` |  | up |
| `top` | `g g` |  | top |
| `bottom` | `G` |  | bottom |
| `half-page-down` | `ctrl+d` |  | half page down |
| `half-page-up` | `ctrl+u` |  | half page up |
| `page-down` | `ctrl+f` |  | page down |
| `page-up` | `ctrl+b` |  | page up |
| `scroll-cursor-top` | `z t` |  | cursor line to the top |
| `scroll-cursor-middle` | `z z` |  | cursor line to the middle |
| `scroll-cursor-bottom` | `z b` |  | cursor line to the bottom |
| `select` | `enter` |  | open / select |
| `open-in-browser` | `o` |  | open in browser |
| `refresh` | `R` |  | refresh |
| `search` | `/` |  | search |
| `next-match` | `n` |  | next match |
| `previous-match` | `N` |  | previous match |
| `cancel` | `esc` |  | cancel / clear |
| `help` | `?` |  | toggle help |
| `command-line` | `:` |  | command line (:q close, :qa quit) |

## Pull request list

The repository's open pull requests (`strig` in a checkout, or `-R owner/name`).

| Action | Keys | Command | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `next-tab` | `l`, `g t` |  | next tab |
| `previous-tab` | `h`, `g T` |  | previous tab |
| `create` | none | `:create` | create a pull request: pick the head and base branches, write the title and body in $EDITOR, then confirm with y/N |
| `create-draft` | none | `:create-draft` | create a draft pull request the same way, without the y/N |
| `copy-url` | none | `:copy-url` | copy the URL of the pull request under the cursor to the clipboard |
| `mark` | none | `:mark` | give the pull request under the cursor a private mark: `:mark <text>` replaces any existing mark |
| `unmark` | none | `:unmark` | remove the private mark from the pull request under the cursor |

## Dashboard

The tabs of sections (`strig` outside a checkout, or with no GitHub remote).

| Action | Keys | Command | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `next-tab` | `g t` |  | next tab |
| `previous-tab` | `g T` |  | previous tab |
| `next-section` | `]` |  | next section |
| `previous-section` | `[` |  | previous section |
| `copy-url` | none | `:copy-url` | copy the URL of the pull request under the cursor to the clipboard |
| `mark` | none | `:mark` | give the pull request under the cursor a private mark: `:mark <text>` replaces any existing mark |
| `unmark` | none | `:unmark` | remove the private mark from the pull request under the cursor |

## Pull request workspace

An open pull request: Overview, Files and Comments panes, and the diff.

| Action | Keys | Command | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `focus-files-pane` | `h` |  | focus files pane |
| `focus-right-pane` | `l` |  | focus right pane |
| `next-file` | `}` |  | next file |
| `previous-file` | `{` |  | previous file |
| `file-picker` | `f` |  | file picker |
| `next-section` | `]` |  | next section (overview) |
| `previous-section` | `[` |  | previous section (overview) |
| `new-comment` | `c` |  | new comment on the diff line / selection (lines only) |
| `new-overview-comment` | `C` |  | new top-level comment on the pull request |
| `reply` | `r` |  | reply to the selected review thread (diff or Comments) |
| `toggle-viewed` | `v` |  | toggle file viewed |
| `toggle-hunk-reviewed` | `m` |  | toggle hunk reviewed at the diff cursor (kept by strig until it quits) |
| `resolve-thread` | `x` |  | resolve or unresolve the selected review thread (diff or Comments; also :resolve, :unresolve) |
| `start-visual-mode` | `V` |  | select diff lines: [count]j/k extend, gg/G extend to boundary, c comment, esc cancel |
| `edit-comment` | `e` | `:edit-comment` | edit the comment of yours under the cursor (diff pane; also :edit-comment) |
| `delete-comment` | `D` | `:delete-comment` | delete the comment of yours under the cursor (diff pane; also :delete-comment) |
| `extend-selection-down` | `j`, `down` |  | extend selection down |
| `extend-selection-up` | `k`, `up` |  | extend selection up |
| `leave-visual-mode` | `esc`, `V` |  | leave visual mode |
| `comments` | none | `:comments` | focus the Comments pane; `all` or `unresolved` filters it to every conversation or only unresolved review threads |
| `resolve` | none | `:resolve` | resolve the selected review thread, after a y/N |
| `unresolve` | none | `:unresolve` | unresolve the selected review thread, after a y/N |
| `react` | none | `:react` | react to the comment under the diff cursor (or pick a target on the Overview); `:react <name>` toggles the named reaction: +1, -1, laugh, hooray, confused, heart, rocket, eyes |
| `approve` | none | `:approve` | submit an approving review, after a y/N |
| `request-changes` | none | `:request-changes` | submit a review that requests changes, after a y/N |
| `review` | none | `:review` | open the review chooser to submit a verdict |
| `merge` | none | `:merge` | merge the pull request after a y/N; `merge`, `squash` or `rebase` picks the method, otherwise the first the repository allows |
| `discard-review` | none | `:discard-review` | delete your pending review and its draft comments, after a y/N |
| `edit-pull-request` | none | `:edit-pull-request` | edit the title and body in $EDITOR, then confirm with y/N |
| `ready` | none | `:ready` | mark the pull request ready for review, after a y/N |
| `draft` | none | `:draft` | convert the pull request back to a draft, after a y/N |
| `checks` | none | `:checks` | list the head commit's checks, failing first; enter opens the selected check in the browser |
| `copy-filename` | none | `:copy-filename` | copy the selected file's path to the clipboard |
| `copy-url` | none | `:copy-url` | copy the pull request's URL to the clipboard |

## Diff pane

Inside the pull request workspace, while the diff has focus. Hunk and thread navigation (next-hunk, previous-hunk, next-thread and previous-thread) also works from the Files pane while a file is selected.

| Action | Keys | Command | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `next-hunk` | `]` |  | next hunk |
| `previous-hunk` | `[` |  | previous hunk |
| `next-thread` | `)` |  | next comment thread |
| `previous-thread` | `(` |  | previous comment thread |
| `toggle-thread` | `z a` |  | toggle comment thread (also enter on a marked line) |
| `open-thread` | `z o` |  | open comment thread |
| `close-thread` | `z c` |  | close comment thread |
| `scroll-left` | `z h` |  | scroll left |
| `scroll-right` | `z l` |  | scroll right |
| `half-scroll-left` | `z H` |  | scroll half a screen left |
| `half-scroll-right` | `z L` |  | scroll half a screen right |

## Commands of every view

These work on any view. A command of a single view is in that view's table above, and a plugin from the config's `plugins:` list is a command of the pull request workspace (see [plugins.md](plugins.md)).

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `:q`, `:quit` | close the current view; quits strig on the first view |
| `:qa`, `:qall`, `:quitall` | quit strig |
| `:set` | change a yes/no option for this session: `:set wrap`, `:set nowrap`, `:set wrap!`, `:set wrap?`, `:set wrap&`; `:set` alone lists the changed options and `:set all` every one |
| `:help` | open a help overlay: `:help` lists the topics, `:help keys` is the key help, `:help config` lists the options |
| `:theme` | switch the colour theme to a bundled theme's name or a theme file |
